rules.intro: Skim rather than watching administrative material
rules.priority: Section outcome + QA evidence, not lecture count

R.name: Rahul Shetty — ML Models AI Testing

A.name: Machine Learning A–Z — first 3 sections only

4.title: StatQuest — Confusion Matrix, Precision and Recall

5.title: Karpathy — Intro to Large Language Models (selected portion)

6.title: Karpathy — Deep Dive into LLMs (selected portion)

days.title: Python bootstrap + Pytest first (no intro marathon)
days.focus: Set up Python/Colab; data types, test functions, assert, test discovery.
days.lab: Run pytest on 3 saved-question-bank membership examples using synthetic questions.

days.title: Finish Pytest foundation + ML test basics
days.focus: Fixtures, conftest, fixture scopes, parametrize, markers; Rahul's AI-vs-ML primer.
days.lab: Parameterize 5 authorized-bank and out-of-bank checks with fixtures; start loading a simple CSV.
days.evidence: 5 pytest cases + fixture file; Section 15 completed.

days.title: Python preprocessing + DeepEval entry + supervised ML
days.focus: Pandas read_csv, missing data, encoding, train/test split; first DeepEval; overfit vs underfit.
days.lab: Build 10-row synthetic candidate dataset and one exact/non-LLM evaluation; describe one data leakage risk.

days.title: Golden dataset essentials + ML model families
days.focus: LLMTestCase, goldens and datasets; clustering, association, reinforcement learning.
days.lab: Annotate 10 synthetic interview answers; assign correct evidence spans and explicit golden labels.
days.evidence: Golden dataset v1 (10 examples) + annotation rules.

days.title: Precision/recall and GEval: measure, don't guess
days.focus: Confusion matrix; accuracy vs precision/recall/F1; custom GEval rubric.
days.lab: Score sample observations for factual grounding and calculate at least one confusion matrix.
days.evidence: Metrics worksheet + draft GEval rubric; identify FP and FN.

days.title: Pytest + DeepEval applied, functional evaluation
days.focus: Move DeepEval from notebook into pytest; data-driven test cases and independent judge rubric.
days.lab: Implement parameterized tests that compare answer evidence to intended competency rubric.
days.evidence: Runnable pytest DeepEval suite with at least 5 cases.

days.title: Inspect the AI application and notebook E2E
days.focus: Application Under Test, session/chat API, event streaming; notebooks for test exploration.
days.lab: Map THL: agent configuration → invitation → permissions → saved-only questions → transcript → observations.
days.evidence: One-page system test map + first transcript-to-observation checklist.

days.title: Multi-turn conversations, API and LangChain
days.focus: Conversation context and relevance; simple LangChain mock; API auth contracts.
days.lab: Create same-session vs cross-session, candidate reconnect, authorization and question-bank boundary scenarios.
days.evidence: 8 API/agent test cases + session trace with evidence.

days.title: RAG, local models and evaluation scope
days.focus: RAG retrieval and grounding; optional Ollama local judge; avoid assuming THL implements RAG.
days.lab: Create one controlled retrieval example with known source; tag THL RAG/MCP as N/A if not used.
days.evidence: RAG benchmark example + justified THL applicability matrix.

days.title: MCP server testing — contracts and permissions (A)
days.focus: MCP tools/resources contract, safe calls, single-turn and authentication boundaries.
days.lab: Run a stubbed tool selection test; deliberately reject access to another org's data.
days.evidence: MCP tool contract table + failed cross-org mock case.

days.title: MCP server testing — conversation and integration (B)
days.focus: Finish MCP eval, chained/tool conversation, permissions and recovery.
days.lab: Test denied tool call, timeout/error, and no unauthorized action; use mock data if THL lacks MCP.
days.evidence: Parameterized tool-call regression with pass/fail evidence.

days.title: Responsible AI and observational fairness
days.focus: Bias, transparency, privacy, safety; GEval judge calibration versus human annotations.
days.lab: Paired equivalent answers across language/accent cues; compare rubric scores without sensitive inferences.
days.evidence: Fairness & privacy risk table + calibrated human/GEval disagreements.

days.title: Post-deployment model QA and test automation
days.focus: Data/concept drift, shadow and A/B testing, smoke/regression, CI strategy.
days.lab: Run a mock back-to-back comparison of two evaluation versions and write a deployment gate.
days.evidence: Release-check spreadsheet: model version, prompt, rubric, dataset and failure categories.

days.title: THL capstone — complete interview, evidence, risk
days.focus: Pareto P0: real THL interview scenario, question bank, evidence and rubric.
days.lab: Execute agent creation/configuration, invitation/expiry, mic/camera, randomized saved questions, recording/transcript/report; do not assume question generation.
days.evidence: Reusable interview E2E checklist and ≥10 evidence-linked assertions.

days.title: Complete remaining administrative sections + QA alignment
days.focus: Skim/mark brief intro and closing sections; audit all E2E 1–15 and Rahul 1–9 section milestones.
days.lab: Identify any section outcomes still missing; repair no more than two priority gaps.
days.evidence: All substantive course sections accounted for; residual gap list.

days.title: Golden evaluation: factuality, repeatability and scoring
days.focus: Independent oracle, claim-level evidence; repeat-run stability, precision and recall.
days.lab: Review 20 synthetic observations and document supported/unsupported claims; repeat equivalent prompts.
days.evidence: Evaluation results table with confidence limitations and FP/FN cases.

days.title: Hardening — regression, privacy and release criteria
days.focus: Threats, prompt injection, data leaks, versioned tests, model performance regression.
days.lab: Run Pytest+DeepEval suite, inspect false-pass/false-reject and approved gate compliance.
days.evidence: Clean regression report and open risks; no unapproved PASS thresholds.

days.title: Final 5-hour E2E AI QA validation + handoff
days.focus: Verify E2E 15 sections, Rahul 9, ML A-Z 3; focus on a functioning and evidence-backed test process.
days.lab: Perform final controlled THL agent workflow and evaluation; deliver team-ready QA report with limitations.
days.evidence: Final pytest results, golden dataset, coverage matrix, defects and release recommendation.
